text.jarAsk: The mystic: "Every voice in this city is gone, and I cannot hear a thing in it. The Silent Order bottles what it steals. Bring me one of their jars from the sewers, and let us hear what it says."
text.jarGiven: The mystic uncorks the jar. The Crier: "They bind our words into a book in the library. The Censor strikes out every page but those written before the Hush. Three survive: one under the Palimpsest, one in the Physician's ledger, one chained in the stacks." She gives you {w}.
text.pagesHere: An unstruck page is on this floor.
text.pagePrompt: Unstruck page: wipe away the ink ({n} left)
text.pageLaid: The page drinks up his ink ({n} left).
text.clapperAsk: The armourer: "The Silent Order tore the clappers out of every bell in the city. A bell with no tongue. If you ever get one ringing again, bring me what's left of it."
text.clapperGiven: The armourer hangs the clapper in the camp's bell, and it rings. "For your trouble. Take your pick of the three."
text.offerAgainArmourer: Your pick is laid out by the forge.
text.offerTakenArmourer: The armourer takes the others back.
